title: Pragmatic Craft
description: The ultimate Vanilla+ experience focused entirely on performance, utility, and modern Quality of Life. Pragmatic Craft brings essential UI, inventory, and optimization tweaks to Fabric without ruining the classic Minecraft feel.
body:
# Pragmatic Craft

Welcome to Pragmatic Craft, a meticulously assembled Vanilla-Plus modpack designed for players who demand peak performance, sleek user interfaces, and meaningful quality-of-life additions without losing the classic soul of Minecraft survival. 

Rather than overwhelming the game with massive tech trees or game-breaking magic systems, Pragmatic Craft takes a practical approach: it leaves the core gameplay loop intact while systematically upgrading how the game runs, handles, and feels.

---

## Features

### Optimization
Say goodbye to stutubs, low frame rates, and poor chunk rendering. Pragmatic Craft integrates top-tier optimization engines to ensure the game runs as smoothly as possible, even on modest hardware:
* **Sodium & Lithium:** Total overhauls to the rendering engine and game physics calculus, drastically reducing CPU/GPU overhead.
* **BadOptimizations & FerriteCore:** Advanced memory and data-structure optimization to minimize RAM usage and eliminate sudden garbage-collection stuttering.
* **ImmediatelyFast & Entity Culling:** Speeds up immediate-mode rendering and stops rendering entities that aren't actively on your screen, saving precious frames in busy bases or mob farms.

### Content
Every piece of content added to the world is chosen for its utility, balance, and vanilla-friendly aesthetic:
* **Backpacked:** Adds fully balanced, wearable backpacks to cleanly expand your inventory while out on long mining trips or exploration treks.
* **Refurbished Furniture:** A beautiful selection of vanilla-styled furniture blocks to make your builds feel alive and functional without breaking the classic art style.
* **Goblin Traders:** Stumble across rare, underground goblin merchants offering unique, high-tier trades for adventurers willing to search the deep caves.
* **Tree Harvester & Ore Veines:** Streamlines the gathering loop by letting you cut down whole trees or mine cohesive ore veins with practical, balanced mechanics.

### Interface
Keep track of your world and manage your items with ultimate precision thanks to modern, intuitive UI overhauls:
* **Xaero’s Minimap & Worldmap:** Seamless, fluid radar and map overlays that track your surroundings, terrain elevation, and entities in real-time. 
* **Just Enough Items (JEI) & Searchables:** Instantly look up recipes, block uses, and filter your inventories cleanly.
* **Inventory HUD+ & Armor HUDs:** Keep an eye on your potion status effects, hand items, and armor durability directly on your main screen without constantly opening your inventory menu.

---

## Setup

### Requirements
* **Multiplayer Ready (Required on Both):** Pragmatic Craft is designated as a Client and Server modpack. Because it introduces tangible blocks, items, and entities (like furniture, backpacks, and goblins), both the server and the connecting clients must run this pack together to prevent registry mismatch errors.
* **Instance Synchronization:** This pack is precisely tuned to its environment target
